decisions.thought: Turn 1: Dragapult likely outspeeds and KOs Garchomp (Draco/Darts), so I switch to Kingambit (resists Dragon/Ghost). Plan: Kingambit Kowtow Cleave or Sucker Punch on Dragapult; watch for Will-O-Wisp, Fire Blast, U-turn. Save Garchomp for Tyranitar/Gengar/Rotom; Dragon Claw OHKOs Dragapult if Garchomp is faster.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Comparing speed tiers: Dragapult's base 142 likely outpaces Mega Garchomp, whose Mega form actually drops speed to around base 92 in this generation, landing near 139. Mega Garchomp's attack jumps to roughly 170 base though, giving strong offensive pressure with Dragon Claw.

Working through damage math, Dragon Claw from Mega Garchomp likely OHKOs Dragapult given its frail defenses, and even non-Mega Garchomp hits hard enough to threaten a KO. But the real risk is Dragapult outspeeding and retaliating with Draco Meteor or Dragon Darts, both of which could knock out Garchomp first. That makes switching to Kingambit the safer play, since it resists both Dragon and Ghost-type attacks and can threaten back with Kowtow Cleave.
